name: asksage-provider
description: Ask Sage model provider for VS Code chat: cache-aware, cost-aware access to Ask Sage's API endpoints in place of the built-in Custom Endpoint (BYOK) route.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The tenant, host and email settings are read only from user settings, so an untrusted workspace cannot redirect requests or the API key.

commands.title: Check Cache Health: Reconcile Recent Usage (free)

asksage.tenant.markdownDescription: Tenant alias (see `config/tenants.js`), or `custom` to use `#asksage.host#`. Application scope: a workspace cannot redirect requests or the bearer token to another host.

asksage.host.markdownDescription: API host used when `#asksage.tenant#` is `custom` (e.g. `api.asksage.ai`). Application scope.

asksage.email.markdownDescription: Account email, used only to exchange the API key for a short-lived access token on `/server` and `/user` endpoints (catalog, rates, budget). Application scope.

asksage.budget.sessionCapTokens.markdownDescription: Hard stop: maximum estimated Ask Sage tokens for one conversation before requests are refused. 0 disables the cap. Left unset, the cap is 10% of your monthly limit, and never above this default; a value you set is used as written. Checked before each request, so the request that crosses it still completes. Every request's estimate is in the [ledger](command:asksage.openLedgerFolder).

asksage.budget.hourlyCapTokens.description: Hard stop: maximum estimated Ask Sage tokens across all conversations in a rolling hour before requests are refused. 0 disables the cap. Left unset, the cap is 25% of your monthly limit, and never above this default; a value you set is used as written.

asksage.budget.warnFraction.description: Pre-flight estimate (PLAN.md §3.5): warn (a notification, and the Ask Sage output channel) once a request's estimated cost would push a session or hourly cap's projected spend past this fraction of the cap, or would leave less than the rest of this fraction of your monthly limit.

asksage.budget.reserveTokens.description: Pre-flight estimate (PLAN.md §3.5): headroom the hard stop keeps back below a session/hourly cap and below your remaining monthly balance, in Ask Sage tokens. 0 stops only once the estimate would reach the limit itself.

asksage.debug.logRequests.markdownDescription: **Writes full request/response text (prompt content included) to local files** under the extension's global storage, for debugging only. Off by default: the ledger never contains prompt text (`CLAUDE.md` security rule), and this setting is the one opt-in exception. Requests are sent to Ask Sage exactly as with this off; the log files themselves stay on this machine and are never uploaded. [Open the request log folder](command:asksage.openDebugLogFolder).

asksage.cache.ttlMode.markdownDescription: Claude (M) cache breakpoint TTLs (PLAN.md §4.1). `mixed` (recommended): the stable tools+system prefix uses the 1-hour TTL and the two most recent message breakpoints use 5 minutes, so a human pause between turns doesn't cost a cold prefix. `5m` or `1h` use one TTL throughout.

asksage.cache.pinToolList.markdownDescription: Send the conversation's first tool list for its whole life instead of whatever Copilot sends each turn. Copilot's tool set can change mid-conversation (an extension registering a tool once it activates), and any change busts the cached prefix on every flavor. Tools Copilot adds later are sent from then on (one full-price turn for the change); tools Copilot later removes are still sent, so the cached prefix stays stable.

asksage.interceptUtilityRequests.markdownDescription: **Off by default.** Detects Copilot's internal 'utility' calls -- generating a chat title or a progress message, not a real answer to you -- by their fixed system-prompt wording, and answers them locally (a title derived from your own request text, a generic progress phrase) instead of spending Ask Sage tokens on them. Detection is a heuristic on exact known phrasing, so it fails open: anything that doesn't match goes through as a normal request. Every intercepted call still appears in the [ledger](command:asksage.openLedgerFolder) as a $0 'intercepted' entry.
